about: Licence texts of the third-party code compiled or linked into the shipped opti/OptiScaler.dll, copied byte for byte from the files named below (url = the file at its commit). release/package.json ships them as licenses/OptiScaler-third-party/ (component optiscaler-fork) with README.md, the index for players; release/test_release_tools.py checks every sha256 and that package.json ships every file.

dll.method: Rechecked the October 25 build: ninja dependency records cover 228 objects and 784 fork-tree input paths. The third-party folder set and static libraries remain those of the prior audit. Between f971ed14 and 03db4f86, the only changed external dependency is Vulkan-Headers, now 1.4.350 (8864cdc896bbc2a9b6eb36b3218fc9ef57908d77). Its LICENSE.md and Apache-2.0 text are byte-identical to the copies here. Other new build inputs are OptiScaler source files. The earlier audit and original notice-source pins are retained below.

previous_dll.method: The reference build of 18 October 2026 (tools/bc250-build.py of the fork): every file of the fork tree in ninja's dependency log (1411 files over 200 objects) and every library on the link line, read for copyright and licence statements; licence texts from each component's repository at the commit named (the pinned submodule commit where the component is a submodule). Checked again for the build of 19 October 2026 (fork commit f971ed14 on upstream master c2e44a8b, sha256 5e570dff): ninja's dependency log of that build (228 objects) names the same third-party folders as the build of 18 October (fork commit a7932870, sha256 244eca5c); its new folders are OptiScaler's own shaders (camera_motion, menu_blur, ui_unblend), which carry no third-party notice; OptiScaler/library (the libraries on the link line) is unchanged; the third-party files that changed between the two commits are external/streamline/sl_helpers_vk.h (NVIDIA, the MIT text of NVIDIA-Streamline-2.txt) and a six-line addition to Dear ImGui's Vulkan backend (OptiScaler's own).
